game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Eldritch Ruins – Pillar Maze, a maze of pillars: the tomb cartographer must handle ghost knights while practicing lists. Core idea – Merge Convoy: Merge two lists using + or extend() to join convoys.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Pillar Maze: a maze of pillars
core_gameplay_loop: In Pillar Maze, repeat each round: Merge two lists using + or extend() to join convoys. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the convoy_size value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Chain 10 consecutive correct decisions about convoy_size to power up the tomb cartographer and open the obelisk.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 7 (applied tier): Merge Convoy
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Merge Convoy' (Week 7 slot 13), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Pillar Maze'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how convoy_size changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ghost knights in Pillar Maze.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 10.
